title: Banff National Park Tour with a Small Group
includes: Transport by climate controlled van or mini coach
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Tour requires a minimum of 4 passengers to operate. If the tour does not meet the minimum 36 hours prior to departure, you will be notified and a full refund will be applied

blurb:
Join a day-long (approximately 11 hours) tour through the Majestic Canadian Rockies! Explore the breathtaking and inspiring scenery that Alberta has to offer. From the intense emerald green hues of the water of Lake Louise, the mystifying valley of the Ten Peaks at Moraine Lake, to Banff, the birthplace of Canada’s first national park, you will be greeted by amazing views of nature your entire trip. Featuring full commentary from your knowledgeable driver/guides, you'll enjoy a truly unique experience. Admission to Banff National Park and complimentary bottled water is included.

Please Note: Seating is limited and the tour requires a minimum of 4 passengers to operate. If the tour does not meet the minimum 36 hours prior to departure, you will be notified and refunded.
